name: A River Across the Ceiling
prompt: Suspend a long transparent aqueduct on slender pink piers, turning at sharp right angles like a floating street. Shoals of neon fish follow the bends. Visitors lie on reed mats underneath to watch their bellies flash.

name: The Reef Goes Visiting
prompt: Arrange individual bubble-shaped tanks in the baskets of a slow chain of tricycles. Each carries one colourful part of a shared reef. At a circular stop the tanks dock through broad glass collars so fish can visit next door.

name: A School of Windows
prompt: Build one immense opaque blue fish of overlapping ceramic scales. Every fifth scale hinges outward to expose a tiny luminous habitat. Keepers balancing on pale wooden fins feed the inhabitants through these scattered openings.

name: The Chromatic Staircase
prompt: Stack shallow glass trays on a long descending stair, each tray tinted by a different species of shrimp or coral. Transparent chutes link the levels. At the foot, an almost colourless nursery receives tiny hatchlings in little sieves.

name: The Kelp Harp
prompt: Make a triangular tank as thin and tall as a harp, strung inside with vertical strands of kelp. Fish loop in and out between the strands. A diver tends its top strings while children trace their shadows below.
